belowGate: On wise0855, mover recall at S/N>=10 is 0.838 and artifact precision is 0.825, under the gate; trees did better there.
evaluation: Leave-one-target-out over 5 SPHEREx target fields; 10,000 test stamps per fold.
data: Fake changes injected into real SPHEREx DR1/QR3 frames. No real movers or variables, no human labels.
selection: CNN chosen over trees on these same held-out folds and test stamps, so this is not an untouched benchmark.
limits: Labels change spots only; it does not find planets. Mover recall is 0.64 at S/N 3-5.
treesNote: Trees saw 600 stamps per class per target, the CNN 2,500: not like-for-like.
